basic_info.description: Experience the charm of Telegraph Hill with this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condominium. Coit Tower views from the bedroom! The open-concept living space is flooded with natural light. Step outside onto your private balcony or indulge in the stunning city views from the shared rooftop deck and sun-room, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Shared Washer/Dryer in basement of building. Located just one block from Grant Avenue and Union Street, you're a short stroll to North Beach's hotspots, vibrant neighborhood restaurants, and iconic attractions. With a perfect 100 Walk Score, minutes from downtown, the Embarcadero, Bay Club, and the Financial District, this home offers both convenience and lifestyle. An ideal choice for first-time buyers or as a stylish pied-a-terre in the heart of the city.
